plainTranslation: Their ambitions and public direction sit right on top of your commitments, limits, and self-discipline.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their ambitions and public direction sit right on top of your commitments, limits, and self-discipline. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
